depth.description: Squat depth measured by knee interior angle (lower is deeper)

torso_lean.description: Forward chest lean relative to gravity vertical

coaching_tips.shallow_depth: Your squat was too shallow. Lower your hips until thighs are at least parallel to the ground.
coaching_tips.excessive_lean: You are leaning your chest too far forward. Keep your chest proud and core tight.
coaching_tips.good_rep: Excellent rep! Deep hip crease and stable upright torso.
